Streptococcus pneumoniae De Novo CPS Locus Discovery & Database Construction

End-to-end validation of de novo polysaccharide locus segmentation (LocusPredictor), polysaccharide-specific CNN role classification (GeneRoleClassifier), hybrid CNN-rescued MCL clustering (Clusterer / Loci.cluster_genes), directed pan-locus graph construction (Loci.as_pan_graph), cross-contig boundary stitching (stitch_contig_splits=True), and database matching (LocusMatcher).

2. De Novo Database All-vs-All Similarity & Whole-Genome CPS Discovery

Left: Pairwise LocusMatcher similarity matrix across the 18 de novo-segmented reference CPS loci (resolving closely related serogroups 6A/6B/6C/6D, 19A/19F, and 23A/23B/23F). Right: Top-1 vs. Top-2 runner-up score separation for CPS loci discovered de novo from complete RefSeq chromosomes.

3. Fragmented Locus Stitching & Leave-One-Out Novelty Detection

Left: LocusPredictor(stitch_contig_splits=True) reconstructs fragmented cps operons split across reverse-complemented contigs (both intergenic and mid-ORF breaks). Right: Holding out each query strain's true locus from the de novo database triggers Match.is_novel (GENE_VARIANT) and falls back to the closest intra-serogroup relative.
